saw_lines: People hand off a bill fight only after it costs them money, and they want one clear result, not features.
So the sale is won or lost on the homepage headline, where a buyer decides if Pine can really cancel their bill.
Your 46 Google creatives carry no proof number, so open the next batch with the billing quote from your site and test it against the 24 text ads.
ads_1: Google text ads that lead with the billing quote and a clear cancel result
